description:
Is this x402 seller a real business with paying users, or a farm/dead
    endpoint? Call it BEFORE your agent pays an unknown x402 endpoint.

    Returns verdict REAL/EMERGING/FARM/DEAD/UNKNOWN + action USE/CAUTION/AVOID
    + is_real (bool) + confidence + payers_30d, calls_30d, repeat-usage ratio
    (calls/payer) and the 11-day demand trend. Farms look like thousands of
    one-shot payers (calls/payer ~1.0); real businesses show repeat usage
    (calls/payer >= 3). Built from our daily sweep of the entire x402 catalog
    (32k+ listings/day, 11 days of history). Unknown seller returns UNKNOWN.
    REST: GET /api/v1/bazaar/seller-verdict ($0.02).

    Args:
        resource: full x402 resource URL (e.g. https://api.example.com/v1/foo)
        domain: or just a domain (e.g. api.example.com)
name: x402_seller_verdict
